title: What the Rhinoceros Hornbill carries

is_this_you.pressure: You get louder when it matters. When the real danger arrives, you go completely silent and start building.
is_this_you.love: You choose out loud, in a duet half the forest hears. After that you stop calling anywhere else.
is_this_you.cost: The colour everyone knows you by takes work. You put it back on every morning, where nobody is watching.

opener.text: When the Iban of Sarawak held Gawai Kenyalang, a carved and painted hornbill was raised high on a pole at the festival's climax [s7]. Hornbills carried word between the god Singalang Burong and the people below [s7]. You were born a Leo in a Dragon year. You were made to be lifted up and heard.

tabs.label: The messenger
tabs.intro: Fire that announces. Earth that holds.

rows.text: Leo is fixed Fire, ruled by the Sun, warm, generous, proud and theatrical [s1] [s2]. The Dragon is yang Earth, brave and confident and happy to take a risk [s3] [s4]. Fire feeds Earth. Your voice fills the forest, and the ground under you takes the weight.

The hornbill's casque is hollow, and researchers think it may help its calls carry, like a resonating chamber [s5]. The bill starts pale. The bird stains it orange and red with oil from its own preen gland [s5] [s6]. Your shine is real. You also keep it up by hand.
Some Ibanic Dayak call the rhinoceros hornbill chief of the worldly birds, and its statue welcomes Sengalang Burong to their feasts [s6]. People put you at the head of the table without asking why.

tabs.label: Walled in
tabs.intro: Mud at the door. One slit left open.

rows.text: The female goes into a tree hollow and seals it with mud, droppings and fruit, the male helping from outside [s5] [s6]. She leaves a slit [s5]. He alone feeds her, up to thirteen times a day [s5]. Love from you runs like that supply line. You call it the plan.
Once the chicks are feathered, the parents chip the dried mud away [s6]. That is your hard day. Pride built the wall, and pride has to take it down.
Broadcast, events, protection work and supply chains all reward a big voice and a delivery route you never miss.

tabs.label: Who brings you food
tabs.intro: Three who keep the slit open. One who pulls you two ways.
tabs.love_lead: In love you court in public. Hornbill pairs duet and hold a head-raised display, and they likely keep one mate for life [s5]. Once committed, a Leo rarely leaves unless bored or disrespected [s2]. You need someone who reads a delivery as romance. The old pairings name three.

easy.why: The Fossa (Aries, Rat year) sits in your trine of Rat, Dragon and Monkey, and Aries is Fire like you [s3] [s1].
The Coati (Sagittarius, Monkey year) closes the trine, and Sagittarius completes the Fire signs with you [s3] [s1].
The Roadrunner (Sagittarius, Rooster year) is your secret friend, since the Rooster is the Dragon's six-harmony partner, and it burns with your Fire [s3] [s4].

hard.why: The hard one is the Vampire Bat (Aquarius, Dog year): the Dog clashes with the Dragon, and Aquarius sits opposite Leo [s3] [s1].

story.text: The Penn Museum records that Gawai Kenyalang was held in prosperous times [s8]. The great hornbill on its pole was sent off to fly away, carrying the forces of misfortune with it [s8]. Households also carved small anak, or child, figures [s8].

closing: Let them raise you high. Whatever was hurting this house leaves on your wings.
